author: Mofumaru
quote: For a two player co-op campaign it doesn't even work as a two player co-op campaign. I went to a jewelry store with lucia and had to play them both to complete the robbery. I had to bash the glass and steal the jewelry myself while the other character just stands there and does nothing. If I rob a store I have to do everything. It's nothing but babysitting the whole game and that's not fun. I can't drive down the road without the game telling me I'm a bad boy also. I shoot one bullet and people die or don't go down yellow if I shoot their limbs until they die. In the hospital scene I was in, the mp5 bloom was so big it was bigger than the people and not a single bullet hit, I burst fired and not a single bullet hit one person I was specifically aiming for and my character died and tried with over two magazines. The automatic weapons are broken and terrible. NPC's standing around not even interacting with the environment. I had NPC's shooting me in front of cops and the cops stand there not even agnologing me getting shot. I'm at a store and I get assaulted and I defended myself I get blamed and then I leave and now I'm considered trying to rob it? I could keep going with nothing but problems. I don't understand the games mechanics currently.
